title: Bram and the Regiment
author: Yara Halloran
blurb: Rafael Yarrow, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
